title: Jolly Briny German Marzipan Casserole
description: A traditional German dish featuring marzipan and a pasta water emulsion, perfect for a sick day. This halal friendly recipe is made in a cazuela vessel.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pasta, marzipan, sea salt, and black pepper.
In a small bowl, whisk together the pasta water and a little bit of olive oil to create an emulsion.
Add the emulsion to the pasta mixture and stir until combined.
Transfer the mixture to a cazuela vessel and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
